values.text: ◎ L E D G E W O R K S

Welcome to The Messenger, our monthly round-up of what’s new in Ledgeworks.

This month: live insights, a connection to your AI assistant, smarter categories, automatic invoice reminders and more.

values.altText: A bar chart of monthly spending with a trend line

values.text: Insights are now in your dashboard, with a live view of your company’s money. Charts update as you go, so you can track trends, compare periods, and ask questions like “Why did software spending go up?”

values.altText: Your account connected to an assistant by dotted lines

values.text: Connect your account securely to the AI assistant you already use. Ask about your finances and explore your data without exporting anything. Access is read-only and you can switch it off at any time.

values.altText: A list of transactions with suggested categories

values.text: We now put your transactions into categories automatically, so you can see where your money goes. You’re always in control: review, approve or change any suggestion, and it learns as you go.

values.altText: A card showing a reminder schedule for an invoice

values.text: Turn on payment reminders and we’ll nudge your customers on a simple schedule: a week before, a day before, a day after and a week after the due date.
●● Plus member? Book time with our team
Plus members can book a session with a specialist to set up their account, walk through key workflows and make sure everything is configured for how they work.

•  Transfer rules can now have nicknames and a history.
•  Sign in faster with passkeys on your phone.

See more in our monthly round-up.

Thanks,
The Ledgeworks team
This email is an advertisement from Ledgeworks.
